categories.main_business_segments: Aramark operates in two main reportable segments: Food and Support Services United States (FSS United States) and Food and Support Services International (FSS International). Both segments provide food, refreshment, specialized dietary, and support services, including facility maintenance and housekeeping, to clients in business, education, healthcare, sports, leisure, corrections, and other sectors. The FSS United States segment accounted for 71% of fiscal 2025 revenue, while FSS International contributed 29%.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Aramark's core operations rely on large-scale food service management, hospitality, and facilities management processes. The company leverages centralized procurement, supply chain management, and operational excellence in food preparation, delivery, and facility services. Technology is used for supply chain optimization, point-of-sale systems, and compliance, while sustainability and safety protocols are embedded throughout operations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Aramark serves institutional clients across five principal sectors: Education (K-12 and higher education), Healthcare (hospitals and senior living), Business & Industry (corporate dining and workplace services), Sports, Leisure & Corrections (stadiums, arenas, parks, and correctional facilities), and Facilities & Other (facility management and procurement services). Its end customers include students, patients, employees, sports fans, and guests at client locations.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s largest market is the United States, supplemented by operations in 15 additional countries, including Canada, Chile, China, Germany, Spain, Ireland, and the United Kingdom. Aramark also provides services on a more limited basis in several other countries and offshore locations, giving it a broad international footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Aramark operates as a downstream service provider, delivering food and facility management services directly to client sites. It manages procurement and supply chain relationships with manufacturers and distributors but does not produce food or goods itself, instead focusing on service delivery and operational execution at the point of consumption.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, Aramark emphasizes organic growth, international expansion, operational efficiency, and innovation in service delivery. Sustainability is a key focus, with the 'Be Well. Do Well.' platform targeting people, planet, and business integrity, including science-based greenhouse gas reduction targets. The company invests in employee development, supply chain optimization, and digital tools to enhance client and consumer experiences.
categories.revenue_model: Aramark generates revenue primarily through long-term contracts with institutional clients. About two-thirds of revenue comes from profit and loss contracts, where Aramark bears all costs and receives all revenue from services provided. The remaining revenue is from client interest contracts, where clients reimburse costs and pay management or incentive fees. Additional revenue streams include vendor rebates and procurement services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Compass Group plc, Sodexo SA, Delaware North Companies, Elior SA, and ISS, as well as numerous regional and local providers. Aramark holds a top 2 position in North America and a top 3 position internationally in most of its significant markets, competing on service quality, breadth, innovation, reputation, pricing, and purchasing scale.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In fiscal 2025, Aramark generated $18.5 billion in revenue, $791.8 million in operating income, and $326.4 million in net income attributable to stockholders. The company has demonstrated consistent growth, with 6.4% revenue growth in 2025 and 8.2% in 2024, driven by base business expansion, new business wins, and international growth. It employs approximately 278,390 people worldwide.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Aramark differentiates itself through its comprehensive, integrated service offerings, deep sector expertise, and ability to deliver tailored solutions for complex client needs. The company emphasizes operational excellence, sustainability, and innovation, positioning itself as a trusted partner that enhances client environments, supports wellbeing, and delivers consistent, high-quality experiences for end users.
